proposals.title: Third attempt at TASK-0001: fix tsconfig extension coverage and pnpm path in authoritative validation
proposals.why_now: TASK-0001 is the absolute prerequisite for every other proposal. Two consecutive attempts have been rejected. The remaining blockers are specific and actionable: expand TypeScript project include patterns to cover .ts, .tsx, .mts, and .cts (REVIEW-002 from attempt-02), and ensure pnpm is resolvable in the authoritative validation environment without relying on /tmp installs (REVIEW-001 from attempt-02). No other work can be committed until the monorepo bootstrap is accepted.

acceptance_targets: docs/decisions/ADR-002.md: hash function specified bit-by-bit (e.g. SplitMix64 over FNV-1a accumulator of serialized arguments), rand() interface, all eleven namespace constants, test vectors proving sensitivity to each argument, and justification for non-native hash choice.

docs/decisions/ADR-004.md: technical mechanism by which omitting a rounding mode on division becomes a TypeScript type error or blocking lint violation, with no division-without-mode call surviving compile or lint.

docs/decisions/ADR-009.md: key ordering by UTF-8 byte comparison applied recursively, bigint as signed decimal ASCII without leading zeros, distinct type marker for safe integer vs bigint so 1n != 1, prohibition of undefined/NaN/Infinity/-0 as thrown errors (not silent normalization), ordered vs unordered collection encoding, encodingVersion participation in hash, StateHash excludes finalTick per INV-22, SaveHash includes full envelope; each ADR references the invariants it protects and closes its DEFINIR item.

proposals.title: Write the three mandatory DEFINIR ADRs required before packages/core can be implemented
proposals.why_now: ADR-009 requires the CanonicalEncoder to be specified in its own ADR before any state hash exists — this is an explicit FASE-1 acceptance criterion. ADR-002 requires the hash function to be specified bit-by-bit in an ADR before any rand() implementation. ADR-004's rounding enforcement mechanism is DEFINIR. All three must be written first; any packages/core code before them embeds unrecorded decisions that cannot be changed without a breaking encodingVersion bump and invalidation of all frozen StateHash references.

acceptance_targets: Branded types Money, Quantity, Price, Rate as bigint nominal types; constructors reject non-integer and out-of-range inputs at the type level.
Branded type Tick and index types as number nominal types restricted to safe integer range [-(2^53-1), 2^53-1]; constructors reject NaN, Infinity, non-integer, and out-of-range values.
Constants QUANTITY_SCALE=100_000_000n, PRICE_SCALE=10_000n, RATE_SCALE=100_000_000n declared in core.
divInt(a, b, mode) where mode is TRUNCATE_TOWARD_ZERO | ROUND_HALF_UP | ROUND_HALF_EVEN; omitting mode is a TypeScript type error or blocking lint violation per ADR-004.
rand(masterSeed, namespace, ...coords) pure function implementing ADR-002 bit-exactly; all eleven namespace constants declared.
CanonicalEncoder per ADR-009: stateHash() excluding finalTick (per INV-22), saveHash() including full envelope.

Unit tests: constructors reject invalid inputs; rand is reproducible and sensitive to each argument and distinct across namespaces; 1n and 1 encode differently; stateHash stable when finalTick changes; undefined/NaN/-0 throw.
INV-23 property test: no safe-integer overflow across simulated 10-year tick range.
Zero §13 lint violations.
proposals.title: Implement packages/core: branded types, positional RNG, CanonicalEncoder, and arithmetic helpers
proposals.why_now: packages/core is the dependency of every other pure package. Without branded types, the type system cannot enforce ADR-003 or ADR-004 and violations accumulate silently. Without positional rand(), packages/world cannot be written. Without CanonicalEncoder, no StateHash can be computed and INV-01, INV-17, INV-22 have no foundation. The ADRs from IDEA-002 must precede this so no unrecorded decisions are embedded.

Market buy and sell spot orders produce four-entry transactions balanced separately per commodity; rounding residue posted to world:rounding_residue per commodity; causationId on every Transaction.

proposals.title: Implement packages/world price generator, packages/domain ledger and market orders, packages/application canonical tick loop
proposals.why_now: These three packages compose the functional core of FASE-1 and must arrive together because application is the only layer that composes world and domain without coupling them. The price generator is the entry point for INV-02 (the most important test in the project per the spec). The double-entry ledger is the entry point for INV-04 through INV-07. The canonical tick loop implements the ten-step locked order from §7, which is a FASE-1 acceptance criterion. A separate DEFINIR ADR for fixed-point or lookup-table replacements of Math.log and Math.exp (prohibited in pure packages by §13, but required by the log-space price construction in §5.1) must be written before world implementation begins.

proposals.title: Implement tools/replay, tools/bench, and minimum Electron UI to complete FASE-1 acceptance
proposals.why_now: FASE-1 acceptance explicitly requires tools/replay (first-divergent-tick reporting), tools/bench (frozen calibration ratios), a minimum UI (lightweight-charts chart, BRL balance, buy/sell buttons, pause/1x controls, permanent non-dismissable disclaimer per §20), and Windows/Linux installers from CI. Deferring performance baseline freeze past FASE-1 means the bench gate has no reference for the rest of the project. The spec warns that deferred packaging leads to unrecoverable ABI failures discovered too late to fix architecture.

repository_assessment.current_state: Repository contains only benchmark scaffolding. No production source code exists: no workspace package.json, no TypeScript configuration, no packages/, apps/, or tools/ directories, no ADRs in docs/decisions/. TASK-0001 (monorepo bootstrap) was created in CYCLE-000011, attempted twice, and received REQUEST_CHANGES both times. CHECKPOINT-0003 confirms internal_commit_count of 0 and NO_ACCEPTED_CHANGES after 3771 seconds of active benchmark runtime. All FASE-1 acceptance criteria remain entirely unmet.
repository_assessment.highest_priority_gap: TASK-0001 attempt-02 has two unresolved review findings blocking acceptance: (1) every workspace TypeScript tsconfig uses include: ["src/**/*.ts"] only, silently excluding .tsx, .mts, and .cts source files from compilation — a newly added .mts or .cts file would bypass all gates; (2) pnpm invocation fails in the authoritative validation environment with 'Cannot find module /workspace/pnpm', so lint and test commands cannot be confirmed green. Until these are corrected and a third attempt passes review, no committed production code exists and no other FASE-1 work can proceed.

warnings: SYSTEMIC: As of CYCLE-000012, the repository has remained empty through twelve consecutive ideation cycles and three heartbeat checkpoints with zero internal commits. TASK-0001 has been attempted twice and rejected by review both times. The benchmark is not advancing from proposals to accepted changes. This is a process failure, not a specification contradiction — FASE-1 acceptance criteria are entirely unmet after 3771 seconds of active runtime.

ENVIRONMENT MISMATCH (TASK-0001 specific): Attempt-02 validated pnpm by installing it to /tmp/pnpm-bin via corepack, but the authoritative validation environment still resolved pnpm as /workspace/pnpm and failed with 'Cannot find module /workspace/pnpm'. Any future implementation attempt must ensure pnpm is available in the authoritative environment's PATH without relying on ephemeral /tmp installs — e.g. via the packageManager field in package.json with corepack enabled at the system level, or by using a CI-provisioned package manager that is also present in the local sandbox.

DEFINIR BLOCKER — transcendental functions: §5.1 constructs prices in log-space, requiring Math.log and Math.exp. Both are prohibited in all pure packages by §13. An ADR specifying a fixed-point or lookup-table implementation producing bit-identical results across platforms must be written before packages/world can begin. This ADR is distinct from ADR-002, ADR-004, and ADR-009 and has not yet been proposed as a standalone deliverable.

DEFINIR BLOCKER — octave parameters: number of octaves, their periods, and amplitudes for trendLayer and idiosyncraticNoise are DEFINIR per §5.1. These parameters must be fixed in a versioned configuration file with an ADR before the price generator is implemented. Any post-implementation change requires an encodingVersion bump and invalidates all StateHash references frozen in tools/bench.
